entries.claim: For every finite selected set S, prefix(counts S) has the same counts and no greater weight.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: Integer epigraph feasibility iff count feasibility, including arbitrary rational linear restrictions; parity substitution retains 2q integer variables. General rational-row encoding size also counts those rows; the executed path constructs bounded integer rows.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: An exchange edge r<s forces each u<v inside [r,s]; components are intervals determined by adjacent edges.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: D of size 2k, k>=2; disjoint two-element subsets P,N can be put into opposite halves of size k.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: All class counts have equal parity. For each fixed interior cut, repartition both prefixes into balanced outputs, both crossing that cut.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: For all bounded z,w with tight feasible prefixes and full coordinatewise parity agreement, each cut z_j+2<=r<=w_j-2 is an adjacent feasible exchange.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: For component-count map A, exchange-direction span E=ker A; A(T)=A(prefix(Z)); nonempty T has dim aff(T)=n-C+dim aff(A(T)).
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: Each parity/endpoint/middle cell admits an affine map agreeing with A(prefix(z)) on its feasible counts; at most 6^q cells.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: For a facet, number of exchange components C<=(3q+1)*2^q.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: Finite augmented-row pivot search and Cramer/Laplace normal construction; affine-basis search from the empty set, at most 2(q+1)^2 ILP calls per cell, bounded coefficients and q^{O(q)} normal-construction cost.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: The span of retained augmented tight prefixes and adjacent exchange directions equals the span of all augmented tight points.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: Finite integer matrices have the same rank over Q and R; augmented rank minus one gives nonempty real affine dimension.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: With valid input, return empty-face dimension -1 or correct nonempty dimension and an affine basis of actual tight points; facet iff valid and dimension n-1.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

entries.claim: Mathematical reference-algorithm cost 2^{O((K+1)log(K+2))} poly(n,L), using cited primitive algorithms; compiler cost verification excluded.
entries.dependency_note: E3 is required by complete_compressed_execution only; the uncompressed weighted execution uses E1/E2/E4. All are explicit local contracts, not project axioms.

entries.claim: Frank-Tardos compression preserves feasibility, equality levels and coefficient classes; unit-cost FPT bound independent of integer magnitudes.
entries.dependency_note: External groups refer to algorithmic existence/cost; semantic encoding, span and geometry statements themselves need no ILP/rank implementation.

external_results.name: 固定维整数线性可行性算法
external_results.not_formalized: 求解器存在性、内部正确性和维数 r 下 r^{O(r)} poly(B) 的复杂度定理。
external_results.proved_here: 原始、奇偶、强制交换各类整数行的等价性、可行见证解码、2q 个有符号整数变量、实际输入大小、调用次数以及费用组合。

external_results.name: 精确有理矩阵秩算法
external_results.not_formalized: 具体消元算法的实现、其正确性及多项式位复杂度；并未提供可运行的高效 ranker 实例。
external_results.supplied_by: 标准精确有理线性代数算法；本文只需整数矩阵上的有理秩。
external_results.proved_here: 输入矩阵确由保留的二进制点构成；插点增秩选择过程正确，次数/矩阵大小有界；Q 与 R 的秩相等、增广秩与仿射维数关系已在项目内证明。

external_results.name: Frank–Tardos 压缩定理
external_results.not_formalized: 压缩算法本身以及一般小符号保持、系数界、多项式位复杂度、强多项式算术操作数和预处理中间有理数位长保证。
external_results.supplied_by: Frank–Tardos (1987)；Etscheid et al., arXiv:1507.03439v1, Theorem 1及其后说明。
external_results.proved_here: 分别作用于 (a,b) 与 (c,d)，取 N=n+2；证明原假设、可行/紧点集、有效性、正系数类数 K 与输出保持，压缩整数负载 ≤18(n+1)^4，并组合两次调用和归一化代价。

external_results.name: 基本算术、访问、排序和集合/矩阵构造算法
external_results.not_formalized: 本地操作的具体高效实现及其机器时间证明；任意附加有理行清分母的一般成本。
external_results.supplied_by: 标准多项式时间整数算术、比较、有限数组/集合处理及排序；常数和多项式次数在参数 q 之前固定。
external_results.proved_here: 具体值规范与算法输出一致；实际整数表达式、法向量候选及中间和的位长、调用所在阶段、次数和合成费用。实际识别路径只构造整数行。
